title: DMRdetector pipeline parameters
description: ONT Methylation Analysis Pipeline — DMR detection from Oxford Nanopore WGS

input_output.title: Input/Output
input_output.description: Required input files and output directory.

input.description: Samplesheet CSV with columns: sample_id, type, meth_bed, vcf

precomputed_references.title: Pre-computed References
precomputed_references.description: Provide pre-built references or override the CpG island panel.

ref_atlas.description: Pre-built autosomal reference atlas (tsv.gz). Skips Stage 1; CpG islands are detected from this atlas unless cpg_panel is also provided.

cpg_panel.description: Optional pre-built autosomal CpG island panel (bed). Overrides atlas-based CpG island detection.

ref_atlas_male_X.description: Pre-built male non-PAR chrX reference atlas (tsv.gz). Required together with --ref_atlas_female_X and --ref_atlas_Y for sex-stratified skip mode.

ref_atlas_female_X.description: Pre-built female non-PAR chrX reference atlas (tsv.gz).

cpg_panel_male_X.description: Optional pre-built male non-PAR chrX CpG island panel (bed).

cpg_panel_female_X.description: Optional pre-built female non-PAR chrX hemi-methylated CpG island panel (bed).

cpg_panel_Y.description: Optional pre-built chrY CpG island panel (bed).

icr_panel.title: ICR Panel
icr_panel.description: ICR panel analysis is enabled by default and runs alongside CpG island DMR detection.
Optional ICR BED override. Must contain ICR regions, not whole imprinting gene bodies. If omitted, ICRs are built from the available reference atlas and icr_gene_list.

icr_gene_list.description: Optional imprinting gene candidate BED override. Defaults to assets/icr_gene_list.bed. Used to build ICR regions from a reference atlas.

icr_ref_meth_min.description: Lower REF_METH bound for defining hemi-methylated ICRs from an atlas.

icr_ref_meth_max.description: Upper REF_METH bound for defining hemi-methylated ICRs from an atlas.

icr_min_sites.description: Minimum CpG sites for ICR panel.

atlas_building.title: Reference Atlas Building (Stage 1)
atlas_building.description: Parameters for building the reference atlas from control samples.

atlas_min_samples_per_site.description: Minimum number of samples per CpG site.

atlas_min_read_coverage.description: Minimum read coverage to include a CpG site.

atlas_shrinkage_weight.description: Empirical Bayes shrinkage weight for dispersion.

smooth_sigma_narrow.description: Narrow Gaussian bandwidth (bp) for FFT smoothing.

smooth_sigma_wide.description: Wide Gaussian bandwidth (bp) for FFT smoothing.

cpg_island_detection.title: CpG Island Detection (Stage 2)
cpg_island_detection.description: Parameters for detecting hypomethylated CpG islands.

cpg_max_gap_distance.description: Max gap for clustering and shore detection (bp).

dmr_detection.title: DMR Detection (Stage 3)
dmr_detection.description: Parameters for differentially methylated region detection.

dmr_merge_distance.description: Max gap for merging CpG sites (bp).

dmr_cpg_min_sites.description: Minimum CpG sites for CpG panel.

chromosome_filter.title: Chromosome Filter
chromosome_filter.description: Control which chromosomes are analysed. Autosomes (1-22) are always included.

include_sex_chromosomes.description: Enable ploidy-aware and X-inactivation-aware sex chromosome analysis: build autosomal, non-PAR male_X, non-PAR female_X, and Y component references using the per-sample sex column from the samplesheet, and call DMRs against sex-appropriate components. Set to false to restrict analysis to autosomes only.

par_bed.description: Override built-in hg38 PAR BED (4-col: CHROM START END NAME) used for non-PAR chrX/Y splitting. Must cover both 'chrX/chrY' and 'X/Y' contig naming.

sex_atlas_min_controls.description: Minimum male or female CTRL count required for sex-specific CASE comparisons.

sex_f_ref_meth_min.description: Female_X hemi-methylated CpG island lower REF_METH bound.

sex_f_ref_meth_max.description: Female_X hemi-methylated CpG island upper REF_METH bound.

sex_f_min_sites.description: Minimum CpG sites for female_X DMRs.

resource_limits.title: Resource Limits
resource_limits.description: Computational resource limits. Auto-detected by default.

max_cpus.description: Maximum total CPUs. Default: min(80% of cores, RAM_GB / 4).

max_memory.description: Maximum total memory. Default: 80% of system RAM.

tmp_dir.description: Local temp directory for work/tmp files. Sets both workDir and TMPDIR. Recommended when inputs are on network storage.
